title: Sea Thyme Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - Modern built 1 bedroom carriage house in fantastic OLD SEAGROVE location - Short walk to the beach- check out aerial shots - EASY Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Beautiful modern coastal decor - Private driveway - Fully stocked kitchen - Two beach cruiser bikes - KING bed - Great room TV with YOU TUBE TV access - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). Easy, breezy Sea Thyme is your new favorite retreat for up to 4 guests in Seagrove Beach! This 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom carriage house has everything you need for a couple’s getaway or family escape – and it is just 400 feet to the beach! This is the Carriage House to Thyme By The Sea which is rented separately. Sea Thyme is the perfect place to relax and enjoy your vacation. Close enough to walk or bike to everything: the beach, galleries, fine cuisine, bike trails, markets, antiques, live theater, a family-run book store, outdoor bazaars and coffee shops! Just a 1/3 mile walk to Seaside! This chic beach home is the perfect vacation spot whether you stay a few days, a week, or a month. Private parking spot out front for one car. White shiplap, tile floors, and crisp colors greet you, along with comfortable, modern furniture. The open-concept downstairs space makes it clear you’ll have everything you need, whether it’s a dining table for 4, or a spacious kitchen with full-size appliances + Keurig. Completing the 1st Floor is a full bathroom with shower plus a full-sized washer and dryer. Upstairs is an additional loft space with a large king bedroom. Ample closet space is available for guests and an additional half-bathroom is located right at the top of the stairs behind a sliding farm door. Curtains help give the loft extra privacy when needed. ACCOMMODATIONS (Sleeps 4): 1st Floor, Living Room: Queen sleeper sofa, kitchen, washer/dryer and full bath 2nd Floor, Loft: King bed. Half bathroom. BEACH ACCESS: Head down Thyme Street, cross 30A and just a few feet west you'll find your beach access, Dogwood-Thyme. Distance: 400 feet | Time: 2 minutes walking IMPORTANT DETAILS: * Please Note: The Main House, Thyme By The Sea, is rented separately. Give us a call if you want to reserve the main house as well. * Parking for 1 car. * Sorry, no pets allowed FREE WIFI Certificate #093850 TDT #29967 Amenities General Air Conditioning Clothes Dryer Hair Dryer Linens Provided Washing Machine Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Blender Oven Dishwasher Keurig Coffee Maker Living Central Air Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Deck Beach Entertainment WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV Netflx, Amazon, & Hulu+ Beach Town Beach Town -
